metas.name: The Adventures of Superboy
metas.description:
The Adventures of Superboy is a series of six-minute animated Superboy cartoons produced by Filmation that were broadcast on CBS between 1966 and 1969. The 34 segments appeared as part of three different programs during that time, packaged with similar shorts featuring The New Adventures of Superman other DC Comics superheroes.

These adventures marked the animation debut of Superboy, as well as his teenage alter ego Clark Kent, who acted as the bespectacled, mild-mannered disguise for the young hero, Lana Lang, and Krypto the super-powered dog who would accompany his master on every dangerous mission. Other characters such as Pa and Ma Kent, foster parents of the Boy of Steel, and the town of Smallville were also faithfully recreated from comic book adventures. As a result of the production's budget, the show featured a great amount of stock animation as well as limited movement from the characters.

metas.description: A Sequel to Justice League Dark (2017) involving Jack Kirby's New Gods.

metas.name: DC Showcase: Adam Strange
metas.description: On a mining ice planet, Adam Strange awaits his chance to return to his own world while drinking himself to oblivion. When the miners unleash a deadly force, things take a horrific turn.

metas.name: Deathstroke: Knights & Dragons - The Movie
metas.description: Assassin Slade Wilson leads two lives: a relentless killer known as Deathstroke and a family man. Can he atone for the sins of the past-or will his family pay the ultimate price?

metas.name: Superman: Man of Tomorrow
metas.description: Daily Planet intern Clark Kent takes learning-on-the-job to new extremes when Lobo and Parasite set their sights on Metropolis.

metas.name: Batman: Death in the Family
metas.description: An anthology series of 5 DC showcase: Death in the Family, Sgt. Rock, Adam Strange, The Phantom Stranger and Death.

metas.name: DC Showcase: The Phantom Stranger
metas.description: Jess joins her friends at a party in a dilapidated mansion hosted by the mysterious Seth. When odd things begin to happen to Jess and her friends, the Phantom Stranger intervenes to save her from a dreary fate.

metas.name: Batman: Soul of the Dragon
metas.description: In the 1970s, a missing teacher of martial arts is the subject of a quest by his devoted and brilliant but distant students, who include Batman.

metas.name: DC Showcase: Kamandi: The Last Boy on Earth!
metas.description: Kamandi and his friends Prince Tuftan of the Tiger Kingdom and humanoid mutant Ben Boxer are kidnapped by a gorilla cult dedicated to finding the reincarnation of their god, The Mighty One.

metas.name: Justice Society: World War II
metas.description: The Justice Society of America, a group of heroes aiding the allies in World War 2, acquire an ally from the future who sends them on an adventure that changes history.

metas.name: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part One
metas.description: Held hostage by the powerful Falcone crime family, Gotham City is rife with crime and corruption. Adding to the chaos is the mysterious Holiday killer, who has been targeting the underworld and leaving a trail of terror - and body...

metas.name: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part Two
metas.description: The killer known as Holiday continues to stalk the Falcone crime family while a new class of costumed criminal rises in Gotham City. Batman suspects that a former ally might be the serial killer.

metas.name: Teen Titans Go! See Space Jam
metas.description: The Teen Titans are visited by the Nerdlucks, the iconic Space Jam (1996) villains. Astonished to discover his fellow Titans have never seen the movie, Cyborg organizes an exclusive watch party.

metas.name: Aquaman: King of Atlantis
metas.description: Alongside trusted allies Mera and Vulko, King Aquaman faces unscrupulous surface dwellers, ancient evils from beyond time, and his half-brother's attempts to overthrow him all to prove that he's the right man for the throne!

metas.name: Injustice
metas.description: On an alternate Earth, the Joker tricks Superman into killing Lois Lane, which causes a rampage in the hero. Superman decides to take control of Earth; Batman and his allies will have to attempt to stop him.

metas.name: DC Showcase: The Losers
metas.description: The legendary rag-tag team of World War II outcasts – Captain Storm, Johnny Cloud, “Mile-a Minute” Jones, rookie Gunner and Sarge – find themselves marooned on an uncharted island in the South Pacific that is completely overrun with dinosaurs! Their would-be ally on this deadly mission, the mysterious and beautiful Fan Long of the Chinese Security Agency, tells them their job is to rescue the scientists that have been sent to study the time/space anomaly. Perhaps… but what is her mission?

metas.name: DC Showcase: Blue Beetle
metas.description: SUFFERIN' SCARABS! Silver Age Blue Beetle is back! Thrill to the adventures of Ted Kord, alias the Blue Beetle, as he teams up with fellow Charlton Comics heroes Captain Atom, The Questions and Nightshade to battle the nefarious finagler of feelings, Doctor Spectro!

metas.name: Batman: The Long Halloween Deluxe Edition
metas.description: Atrocious serial killings on holidays in Gotham City send The World's Greatest Detective into action - confronting both organized crime and a unified front of classic DC Super-Villains - while attempting to stop the mysterious mur...

metas.name: Catwoman: Hunted
metas.description: Follows Catwoman in an attempt to steal a priceless jewel. This puts her squarely in the crosshairs of both a powerful consortium of villains, Interpol and Batwoman.

metas.name: Constantine: The House of Mystery
metas.description: Occult detective John Constantine is trapped in the House of Mystery, a secret domain where none can escape from.

metas.name: Teen Titans Go! & DC Super Hero Girls: Mayhem in the Multiverse
metas.description: Teen Titans and DC Super Hero Girls will reunite to combat Lex Luthor and his unified gang of DC Super-Villains.

metas.name: DC League of Super-Pets
metas.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, Krypto must master his own powers for a rescue mission when Superman is kidnapped.

metas.name: Green Lantern: Beware My Power
metas.description: Recently discharged Marine sniper John Stewart is at a crossroads in his life, one which is only complicated by receiving an extraterrestrial ring which grants him the powers of the Green Lantern of Earth.

metas.name: Batman and Superman: Battle of the Super Sons
metas.description: Jonathan Kent and reluctant young sidekick Damian Wayne are burdened with saving the world from impending doom. The two must join forces to rescue their fathers and save the planet by becoming the super heroes they were intended t...

metas.name: Batwheels
metas.description: The Batwheels are a team of sentient super-powered crimefighting vehicles that help Batman, Robin and Batgirl—as well as a host of additional DC Super Heroes—keep Gotham City safe. Created only recently by the Batcomputer, our mechanized heroes must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super-team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

metas.name: Legion of Super-Heroes
metas.description: Kara, devastated by the loss of Krypton, struggles to adjust to her new life on Earth. Superman mentors her. Meanwhile, she must contend with a mysterious group called the Dark Circle who searches for a powerful weapon held in the...

metas.name: Batman: The Doom That Came to Gotham
metas.description: An ancient evil awakens and only Bruce Wayne can save 1920s Gotham City.

metas.name: Justice League x RWBY: Super Heroes & Huntsmen, Part One
metas.description: The DC universe's premier superhero team are transported to the world of Remnant where they are transformed into teenagers and must join forces with Team RWBY to fight against superpowered Grimm.

metas.name: My Adventures with Superman
metas.description: Clark Kent builds his secret Superman identity and embraces his role as the hero of Metropolis, while sharing adventures and falling in love with Lois Lane, a star investigative journalist, who also takes Jimmy Olsen under her wing.

metas.name: Justice League: Warworld
metas.description: Warworld, a place of unending brutal gladiatorial combat, Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman and others must unite to form an unbeatable resistance to lead the entire planet to freedom.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! and Krypto, Too!
metas.description: Follows Scooby-Doo and Mystery Inc. as they are looking into the disappearance of the Justice League.

metas.name: Merry Little Batman
metas.description: Damian Wayne is left alone at home while his father, Batman, goes out to help the Justice League on Christmas Eve, but ends up discovering a plot in Gotham to steal Christmas and take the chance to be a superhero like Batman.

metas.name: Justice League x RWBY: Super Heroes & Huntsmen, Part Two
metas.description: After their adventure in Remnant cyberspace, courtesy of Kilg%re, the Justice League returns to Earth. However, they find the Grimm have followed them and are somehow duplicating their powers. Bringing Black Canary up to speed, th...

metas.name: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths Part One
metas.description: The Anti-Monitor, the Monitor's evil counterpart, is released into the DC Multiverse and begins to destroy the different Earths that compose it. The Monitor attempts to recruit heroes from across the Multiverse to fight back.

metas.name: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths Part Two
metas.description: The Anti-Monitor (the Monitor's evil counterpart) is released into the DC Multiverse and begins to destroy the different Earths that compose it. The Monitor attempts to recruit heroes from across the Multiverse to fight back.

metas.name: Suicide Squad Isekai
metas.description: Harley Quinn, The Joker, and the Suicide Squad cause havoc in ISEKAI*, an all-new original anime series from Warner Bros. Japan and WIT Studio. *ISEKAI(???): Term for "another world" in Japanese.

metas.name: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths Part Three
metas.description: Trapped in a pocket universe, surviving Earths face annihilation by the Anti-Monitor. Time shatters, bringing past heroes to aid Justice League against the epitome of evil. Their sacrifice may lead to victory.

metas.name: Kite Man: Hell Yeah!
metas.description: The adventures of the minor villain Kite Man as he commits crimes to support the purchase of Noonan's, Gotham's seediest dive bar.

metas.name: Batman: Caped Crusader
metas.description: After a family tragedy, affluent philanthropist Bruce Wayne transforms into The Batman, where his crusade for justice spawns unforeseen ramifications.

metas.name: Watchmen: Chapter I
metas.description: In 1985, the murder of a government sponsored superhero draws his outlawed colleagues out of retirement and into a mystery that threatens to upend their personal lives and the world itself.

metas.name: Watchmen: Chapter II
metas.description: In an alternate 1985 America, a group of retired superheroes investigate a conspiracy after one of their own is murdered.

metas.name: Creature Commandos
metas.description: A group of nonhuman criminals comprised of an anthropomorphic weasel, a robot, the bride of Frankenstein, a radioactive skeleton, and their human leader are tasked with stopping an evil sorceress.

metas.name: DC Heroes United
metas.description: When the story of Earth-212 begin,s our favorite Super Heroes and Super-Villains remain in the shadows, largely unknown to one another and mostly serving as legend and rumor to civilians. The appearance of the magical Tower of Fate in Gotham City thrusts these fledgling heroes into the spotlight – together and in opposition.

metas.name: Beast Boy: Lone Wolf
metas.description: Beast Boy embarks on his first solo adventures, proving he can be a superhero without the Teen Titans – even if no one believes him!

metas.name: Batman Ninja vs. Yakuza League
metas.description: Batman is confronted by an invasion from an alternate world of Japan, that has its own version of the Justice League.

metas.name: Aztec Batman: Clash of Empires
metas.description: A young Aztec boy experiences tragedy when his father is murdered by Spanish Conquistadors. Yohualli escapes to Tenochtitlan to warn King Moctezuma and his high priest, Yoka, of imminent danger.

metas.name: Bat-Fam
metas.description: Follow Batman, Alfred, and young Damian Wayne—who has taken on the mantle of Little Batman—alongside a few newcomers to Wayne Manor, as they navigate the fun and frustrations of life as a super family

metas.name: Krypto Saves the Day!
metas.description: Krypto the Superdog wants to be a good boy, but he can't help but make mischief for the citizens of Metropolis.

metas.name: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
metas.description: When the mysterious behemoth known only as Bane frees Batman's entire rogue's gallery from Arkham Asylum, the Caped Crusader is pushed to his mental and physical breaking point.

metas.name: Get Jiro!
metas.description: In a future LA controlled by elite chefs, a sushi master named Jiro gets embroiled in a vicious culinary conflict, seeking vengeance through his cooking skills amidst the cutthroat restaurant scene.

metas.name: Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest
metas.description: Batman lies broken at the hands of the villainous mastermind Bane. With Bruce Wayne paralyzed from the waist down and unable to continue as Batman, a new successor must be chosen to defend Gotham City. Jean-Paul Valley, the man also known as Azrael, must take up the mantle of the Batman. But will his more violent methods be enough to stop Bane?

metas.name: Dynamic Duo
metas.description: Follow the early days of Dick Grayson and Jason Todd and explore how their friendship becomes tested by their diverging ideas for what their future should be.
